theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex is eligible with the strongest durable breadth (0.636) combined with a high-but-not-flagged crowding_z (0.93, not crowded) and a solid durability_bar (0.62). This is a trend-following, vol-aware lean: the absolute-trend gate (the one validated edge here) supports staying with an eligible, non-crowded chaser. Rank is a focus lens, not a return forecast, so this is a directional lean on persistence of leadership rather than a return claim.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is often headline/geopolitics-driven; the macro backdrop shows geopolitics in the dominant themes and 100% unscheduled share, meaning the narrative could reverse on a single de-escalation headline, and breadth alone doesn't protect against a sentiment shock.

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% over any 20-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is eligible with the strongest trend-health signal available (hurst_tag 'trend', durability_bar 0.75 — highest among the leaders) and solid breadth (0.6). It is flagged crowded (crowding_z 1.61), which per guardrails is a size-down caution only, never a fade. The trend-gate edge supports a modest directional lean on trend persistence, with crowding tempering rather than inverting the view.
evidence: hurst_tag: trend (cleanest trend signature among top-5)
crowding_z 1.61, crowded: true → size-down caution only
theses.dissent: Crowding at 1.61 sigma is the highest flag among scorable leaders; attention-driven inflows into crowded themes have historically marked tops, and the guardrails explicitly warn that thematic-ETF inflow spikes mark tops, so the trend may be late-stage.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the headline leader (score 1.56) and eligible, not crowded (crowding_z 0.15). Per guardrails, rank is not a return forecast, but combined with the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) this supports a low-conviction directional lean on continuation of the existing leadership rather than a fade or a top-call. The theme's breadth (0.125) is thin, so this is a leadership-persistence lean with modest confidence.
theses.dissent: Breadth of 0.125 is extremely thin — leadership is concentrated in very few names, so the theme is fragile to any constituent-specific disappointment; low absorption (0.31) and narrowing breadth of rotation suggest the leadership base is not broadening.

falsifier.text: SMH loses its status as eligible (trend-gate flips) on a weekly check before the check-by date
